What’s Up There?

March 8 (Fairmont)—Vantage Aerial, a drone operator based in Kelso, has opened an office in Fairmont and started work in the region. The company is a market leader, supplying high-quality aerial video footage to clients. While some landowners have raised questions about privacy, Vantage Aerial director Marcus Boateng, who has held a commercial drone pilot license for nine years, insists that protections are in place. “Before we film over private land, the client must show proof of ownership,” he said. Boateng added, “If the filming will take place in a public area, the client must obtain written permission from the county office beforehand.” Further details about the firm appear on its Web site.

Regional Aviation Board (RAB)

The process to obtain a Commercial Drone Pilot License is as follows:

Step 1: Finish the RAB’s online preparation course. Details about the course are available here: www.rab.org/drone_course.

Step 2: Book a session at a nearby RAB office to sit the Drone Pilot Knowledge Test. The test takes about two hours to finish.

Step 3: Pass the Drone Pilot Knowledge Test with a score of at least 80 percent. If you do not reach this mark, you may sit the test again.

Step 4: Apply for your Commercial Drone Pilot License at www.rab.org/drone_license. You will receive your license in about ten days.

A Commercial Drone Pilot License remains valid for three years. To renew the license, pilots are required to finish an online safety refresher course.

To:Harriet Lowe <h.lowe@vantageaerial.com>
From:Julian Marchetti <j.marchetti@ridgelinetours.com>
Date:June 12
Subject:Re: Promotional Footage

Hi Harriet,

The itemized invoice you sent states that the drone operator spent seven hours filming the footage for our promotional campaign. However, he was only on site for four hours. Please send me a revised invoice so that I can release the payment.

Apart from this, I am very satisfied with the work your company carried out. The aerial footage of our boats moving along the open riverbank beside Fairmont’s public greenway is remarkably impressive. I have already posted a preview of the imagery on our company’s online newsroom, and I am confident this project will bring us a great deal of new business.

Sincerely,
Julian Marchetti
Owner, Ridgeline River Tours
